question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. However, this measure alone is insufficient to curb the underlying systemic issues. || B. The central bank recently announced a significant hike in the benchmark interest rates. || C. These issues are deeply rooted in global supply chain disruptions. || D. Therefore, a multifaceted approach involving fiscal policy adjustments is urgently required. || E. Its primary goal was to control the spiraling inflation that has plagued the economy.
explanation: Sentence B starting intro hai kyunki yeh independent statement hai hike ke baare mein. Sentence E mein 'Its primary goal' central bank ke hike ko refer karta hai, toh B-E ki pair banegi. Sentence A mein 'this measure' wapas interest rate hike ko point karta hai aur limitation batata hai. Sentence C ka 'These issues' directly A ke 'systemic issues' se link hota hai (A-C link). D 'Therefore' ke sath paragraph conclude karta hai.
trick: Jab bhi 'Therefore' ya 'Thus' dikhe, samajh jao wo mostly concluding (last) sentence hoga. D last mein aayega.
tip: Demonstrative pronouns ('these', 'this') ke theek pehle unka original noun aana chahiye.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. These ethical dilemmas include concerns about data privacy and algorithmic bias. || B. Artificial Intelligence has made unprecedented strides in healthcare diagnostics. || C. Consequently, policymakers are scrambling to draft comprehensive regulations. || D. Despite its clinical success, the deployment of such systems raises severe ethical dilemmas. || E. Without such guidelines, the unchecked growth of this technology could lead to severe societal harm.
explanation: B ek broad introduction hai AI in healthcare ke baare mein. D mein 'its clinical success' AI ki healthcare diagnostics (B) ko refer karta hai, isliye B ke baad D aayega. D end hota hai 'ethical dilemmas' par, aur A start hota hai 'These ethical dilemmas' se, toh D-A ek strong mandatory pair hai. C mein 'Consequently' result batata hai A ka, aur E mein 'such guidelines' C ki 'regulations' ko point karta hai.
trick: Acha trap D hai kyunki wo intro lagta hai, but 'its' pronoun ki wajah se wo first sentence nahi ho sakta.
tip: Word matching trick: D ka last word (dilemmas) A ka first word hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Such extreme weather events displace millions of vulnerable citizens every year. || B. The government has pledged to achieve net-zero emissions by the year 2070. || C. Yet, the immediate reality on the ground is marked by devastating floods and droughts. || D. To mitigate this suffering, massive investments in climate-resilient infrastructure must be prioritized. || E. This ambitious target requires a complete overhaul of the current energy sector.
explanation: B introduces the government's pledge. E mein 'This ambitious target' directly B ke 'net-zero emissions' pledge ko refer karta hai (B-E pair). C 'Yet' se start hokar ground reality (floods/droughts) batakar contrast create karta hai. A mein 'Such extreme weather events' C ke 'floods and droughts' ko refer karta hai (C-A pair). D conclude karta hai solution batakar, jisme 'this suffering' A ke 'displace millions' se link hai.
trick: 'Yet' ek contrast word hai. B aur E future plans hain, C present reality dikhata hai, isliye transition C se hoga.
tip: 'Such' keyword hamesha us cheez ke baad aata hai jiska example diya ho.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Conversely, those that failed to adapt quickly burned through their cash reserves. || B. The startup ecosystem witnessed a massive funding winter last year. || C. This harsh economic climate forced many founders to drastically pivot their business models. || D. As a result, several once-promising unicorns were forced to shut down completely. || E. Those who successfully pivoted managed to survive the drought and even achieved profitability.
explanation: B paragraph ka central theme (funding winter) set karta hai. C mein 'This harsh economic climate' B ke 'funding winter' ko point karta hai (B-C pair). E batata hai un startups ke baare mein jinhone pivot kiya (C ke sequence mein). A mein 'Conversely' unka contrast dikhata hai jo fail ho gaye. D 'As a result' use karke fail hone walo ka final result (shut down) batata hai, jo A se linked hai.
trick: A aur E mein contrast hai. Pehle positive pivot (E) aayega, fir 'Conversely' lagakar negative result (A) aayega.
tip: 'Conversely' opposite ideas ko jodne ke kaam aata hai. Dono ideas dhoondo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. The James Webb Space Telescope has revolutionized our understanding of the early universe. || B. This specific capability allows it to peer through dense cosmic dust clouds. || C. By doing so, astronomers can observe the formation of the very first galaxies. || D. Unlike its predecessor Hubble, it operates primarily in the infrared spectrum. || E. These observations are crucial for answering fundamental questions about cosmic evolution.
explanation: A general intro hai James Webb Telescope ka. D mein 'it operates' A ke telescope ko describe karta hai. B mein 'This specific capability' D ke 'infrared spectrum' ko point karta hai (D-B link). C ka 'By doing so' B ke 'peer through dense cosmic dust' ka result hai. E mein 'These observations' C ke 'observe the formation' se closely linked hai.
trick: Students B ko D se pehle rakh sakte hain, but 'This specific capability' ko base chahiye, jo D mein 'infrared spectrum' hai.
tip: Nouns aur unke reference action verbs (observe -> observations) ki pairing karo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. The transition to digital learning was abruptly forced upon the education sector during the pandemic. || B. For instance, rural students often lacked access to reliable internet and personal devices. || C. This sudden shift highlighted the glaring digital divide prevalent in developing nations. || D. Consequently, a large portion of the student population was left behind academically. || E. To bridge this gap, public-private partnerships must urgently provide subsidized technological tools.
explanation: A main event (transition to digital learning) batata hai. C ka 'This sudden shift' directly A ki 'transition' ko refer karta hai aur 'digital divide' introduce karta hai (A-C pair). B 'For instance' se C ke 'digital divide' ka example deta hai (C-B pair). D 'Consequently' use karke B wale bacchon ka result (left behind) batata hai. E solution hai jo 'this gap' (digital divide/left behind students) ko bridge karne ki baat karta hai.
trick: Agar 'For instance' dikhe, toh dekho wo example kis cheez ka hai. Yaha rural students 'digital divide' (C) ka example hain.
tip: Problem, example, effect aur fir solution. Yeh standard passage structure hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. These tariffs were initially intended to protect domestic manufacturing industries. || B. The imposition of new tariffs has sparked fears of a looming global trade war. || C. Instead of flourishing, local businesses are now facing higher costs for imported raw materials. || D. Furthermore, retaliatory measures from partner nations have severely hampered export volumes. || E. However, the actual outcome has been quite contradictory to these initial expectations.
explanation: B opening sentence hai jo 'new tariffs' ka topic lata hai. A mein 'These tariffs' B ko refer karta hai aur unka initial purpose batata hai (B-A pair). E mein 'However' lagakar A ki 'initial expectations' ko contradict kiya gaya hai. C detail mein batata hai ki contradictory outcome kya tha (businesses facing higher costs). D 'Furthermore' se ek aur negative outcome add karta hai.
trick: 'However' E mein hai, jo A ke positive tone (protect industries) ko negate karke C ke negative tone (higher costs) ki taraf le jata hai.
tip: Chronology check karo: Intention (A) -> Reality check (E) -> Reality facts (C, D).

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This rapid influx has severely strained existing urban infrastructure. || B. Rapid urbanization is pushing millions of people from rural areas into metropolitan cities. || C. Traffic congestion and inadequate waste management are just two symptoms of this strain. || D. Therefore, urban planners must adopt sustainable and futuristic city-building models. || E. Addressing these symptoms requires more than just superficial infrastructural patchwork.
explanation: B is the root cause statement (urbanization pushing people). A mein 'This rapid influx' B ke 'pushing millions' movement ko refer karta hai (B-A pair). C mein 'this strain' A ke 'strained infrastructure' ka example deta hai (A-C pair). E mein 'these symptoms' C ke 'two symptoms' (traffic, waste) ko link karta hai. D 'Therefore' se conclusion aur solution provide karta hai.
trick: A aur C ko ulta mat karna. 'This strain' (C) aane ke liye pehle 'strained' (A) word ka aana zaroori hai.
tip: Noun aur pronoun ka number (singular/plural) match kiya karo linking mein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Solar power has emerged as a frontrunner in the race for clean energy alternatives. || B. One major hurdle is the intermittent nature of sunlight, making round-the-clock supply difficult. || C. Despite its growing popularity, widespread adoption still faces significant technological hurdles. || D. To overcome this, massive advancements in battery storage technologies are imperative. || E. Without such advancements, relying solely on solar energy remains an unrealistic goal.
explanation: A introduce karta hai solar power ko. C mein 'Despite its growing popularity' A ko refer karta hai aur 'technological hurdles' introduce karta hai (A-C link). B mein 'One major hurdle' specifically C ki hurdles ka part batata hai (C-B pair). D mein 'To overcome this' B ke problem (intermittent nature) ka solution (battery storage) batata hai. E 'Without such advancements' sidha D ki battery advancements se jura hai.
trick: C mein plural 'hurdles' hai aur B mein singular 'One major hurdle' hai, so C broad general statement hai jo B se pehle aayega.
tip: Broad general problem hamesha specific problem se pehle aati hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This decentralized nature, however, also makes them highly volatile and risky. || B. Cryptocurrencies were designed to operate independently of traditional banking systems. || C. Consequently, retail investors often suffer huge losses during market crashes. || D. They achieve this independence through a technology known as blockchain. || E. To protect these vulnerable investors, regulatory bodies are now stepping in globally.
explanation: B Cryptocurrency ki independent design batata hai. D ka 'They achieve this independence' B ki banking independence ko refer karta hai (B-D pair). A ka 'This decentralized nature' D ki blockchain technology ka effect batata hai, aur sath mein risk introduce karta hai. C 'Consequently' lagakar A ke risk aur volatility ka result (losses) batata hai. E 'these vulnerable investors' C ke 'retail investors' se link hokar conclude karta hai.
trick: Sentence D mein 'They' hai jo 'Cryptocurrencies' (B) ke liye use hua hai. D kabhi first nahi ho sakta.
tip: 'This' + noun combo hamesha previous sentence ke kisi point ko summarize karta hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This dual burden places immense pressure on an already fragile healthcare system. || B. Developing countries are currently facing a unique double burden of diseases. || C. On one hand, infectious diseases like malaria continue to claim thousands of lives. || D. Ultimately, addressing this requires a massive increase in the public health budget. || E. On the other hand, lifestyle diseases such as diabetes are rising at an alarming rate.
explanation: B introduces 'double burden of diseases'. C 'On one hand' se pehla burden batata hai aur E 'On the other hand' se dusra burden batata hai, so C-E strictly ek pair banenge. A mein 'This dual burden' C aur E dono ko mila kar describe kar raha hai, toh yeh C-E ke baad aayega. D paragraph ko 'Ultimately' word se ek strong financial solution dekar conclude karta hai.
trick: 'On one hand' aur 'On the other hand' hamesha ek strict sequence follow karte hain (Pehle C, fir E). Beech mein kuch nahi aayega.
tip: Correlative conjunctions (One hand... other hand) strong mandatory pairs banate hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. The technique acts like genetic scissors, allowing scientists to cut and edit DNA sequences. || B. CRISPR-Cas9 is hailed as one of the most significant biological breakthroughs of the century. || C. If misused, these permanent alterations could lead to unforeseen genetic abnormalities. || D. While the medical potential is vast, it also opens a Pandora's box of ethical issues. || E. The most prominent ethical issue involves the possibility of creating 'designer babies'.
explanation: B main subject 'CRISPR-Cas9' introduce karta hai. A 'The technique' use karke B ko explain karta hai ki wo kaam kaise karti hai (B-A pair). D shift of tone karta hai 'vast potential' se 'ethical issues' ki taraf. E directly D ka specific example deta hai 'most prominent ethical issue' bolkar (D-E pair). C mein 'these permanent alterations' E ke 'designer babies' ko banate waqt hone wale DNA changes ko refer karta hai.
trick: C last aayega kyunki 'these permanent alterations' tabhi sense banata hai jab 'designer babies' (E) jaisi badi cheez ki baat ho.
tip: Lexical repetition dhoondo: Sentence D end hota hai 'ethical issues' pe, E start hota hai ussi word se.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Brick-and-mortar retail stores are struggling to compete with these digital giants. || B. The e-commerce sector has witnessed exponential growth over the last decade. || C. To survive, traditional retailers must integrate omnichannel strategies into their operations. || D. This growth is primarily driven by the increasing penetration of smartphones. || E. Consequently, many legacy brands have been forced to file for bankruptcy.
explanation: B 'e-commerce sector' ki growth introduce karta hai. D mein 'This growth' seedha B ko point out karta hai (B-D pair). A mein 'these digital giants' e-commerce sector (B, D) ko point karke unka retail stores par impact batata hai. E 'Consequently' lagakar retail stores (A) ki struggling ka negative result batata hai. C 'To survive' bolkar E ke negative result se bachne ka solution deta hai.
trick: 'These digital giants' (A) ko samajhne ke liye pehle E-commerce sector (B) aur uski power (D) ka set hona zaroori hai.
tip: Solution wala sentence (C) hamesha negative impact (E) ke baad aata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This phenomenon has severely undermined public trust in mainstream journalism. || B. Social media platforms have democratized the dissemination of news and information. || C. To combat this menace, strict fact-checking mechanisms must be implemented globally. || D. However, this lack of editorial oversight has also led to the rampant spread of fake news. || E. Rebuilding that trust will require a concerted effort from both creators and consumers.
explanation: B introduces social media ka positive point (democratized news). D 'However' lagakar B ko contradict karta hai aur fake news introduce karta hai (B-D pair). A mein 'This phenomenon' D ke fake news spread hone ko bol raha hai, jisse trust undermine hua. E mein 'that trust' directly A ke 'public trust' ki baat kar raha hai (A-E pair). C 'this menace' (fake news ka issue) ko solve karne ka broad global solution deta hai.
trick: Sentence E aur C dono conclusions lag sakte hain, lekin E ka 'that trust' seedha A se jura hai, isliye E aayega C se pehle.
tip: Paragraph ka last sentence hamesha sabse broad solution ya macro-level view deta hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. These incentives include tax rebates and subsidies for early adopters. || B. Despite these financial pushes, range anxiety remains a massive deterrent for buyers. || C. The transition towards Electric Vehicles (EVs) is accelerating globally. || D. Governments worldwide are providing aggressive incentives to promote this transition. || E. Overcoming this anxiety requires a denser and more reliable charging infrastructure network.
explanation: C broad introduction hai EV transition ke baare mein. D 'this transition' use karke C se link karta hai aur government incentives introduce karta hai. A 'These incentives' bolkar D ki baat ko detail me batata hai (D-A pair). B 'Despite these financial pushes' use karta hai jo ki A ke subsidies ko refer karta hai aur naya problem (range anxiety) lata hai. E mein 'this anxiety' seedha B ki 'range anxiety' ko refer karke usko overcome karne ka solution deta hai.
trick: Financial pushes (B) tab tak nahi aa sakta jab tak A mein incentives aur subsidies explicitly mention na hon.
tip: Acronyms (EVs) jisme define hote hain wo mostly first sentences hote hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. The gig economy has fundamentally transformed the traditional employer-employee relationship. || B. Furthermore, they miss out on critical social security benefits and health insurance. || C. While it offers unprecedented flexibility, it also strips workers of basic job security. || D. Consequently, labor unions are demanding reclassification of these workers as full-time employees. || E. Independent contractors often find themselves vulnerable to sudden algorithmic deactivations.
explanation: A intro statement hai about gig economy. C 'it offers' use karke gig economy (A) ke pros aur cons (flexibility vs lack of security) batata hai. E ek specific example deta hai un contractors ka jo vulnerable hain (C ka negative aspect). B 'Furthermore, they' se E wale contractors ko aur kya nuksan hota hai wo add karta hai (E-B pair). D 'Consequently' use karke in sabhi exploitation ka final outcome (labor union demands) dikhata hai.
trick: B mein 'they' independent contractors (E) ke liye hai, na ki gig economy ke liye. Toh E pehle aayega aur B uske baad.
tip: Addition words like 'Furthermore' same flow of tone (negative yaha par) maintain karte hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This scarcity is exacerbated by rampant groundwater extraction and inefficient agricultural practices. || B. Several major metropolitan cities are currently staring at 'Day Zero' scenarios. || C. The global freshwater crisis has reached an unprecedented and alarming tipping point. || D. To avert this disaster, strict water rationing and conservation mandates must be enforced. || E. Such a scenario means the municipal water supply will be completely shut off.
explanation: C starting theme hai global freshwater crisis ka. A 'This scarcity' bolkar C ke crisis/water shortage ko explain karta hai. B is scarcity ka effect batata hai cities par aur 'Day Zero' ka naam leta hai. E 'Such a scenario' use karke B ke 'Day Zero' ko define karta hai (B-E solid pair). D 'this disaster' (jo ki Day Zero wali condition hai) ko avert karne ka solution deta hai.
trick: D aur E mein confusion ho sakti hai. E define karta hai condition ko, D usse bachne ka solution deta hai, isliye D end me aayega.
tip: Pehle kisi naye term ('Day Zero') ko introduce karo, fir usko define karo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This structural adaptability allows the brain to recover from severe traumatic injuries. || B. Neuroplasticity refers to the brain's remarkable ability to reorganize itself continuously. || C. By forming new neural connections, undamaged areas can take over the functions of damaged ones. || D. However, this recovery process is not automatic and requires rigorous physical therapy. || E. It achieves this reorganization by forming completely new neural connections throughout life.
explanation: B intro hai jo 'Neuroplasticity' aur 'reorganize' define karta hai. E 'It achieves this reorganization' se directly B se link karta hai (B-E pair). A mein 'This structural adaptability' E ke structure changes (connections) ko summarize karta hai. C 'new neural connections' ka effect (undamaged taking over damaged) batata hai jo A ke 'recover' point ko aur clear karta hai. D 'this recovery process' use karke A aur C ki recovery ka limitation batata hai.
trick: A aur C ka sequence tricky hai. A broad statement deta hai recovery ka, aur C us recovery ka exact mechanism batata hai, isliye A-C flow better hai.
tip: Mechanism of action general statement ke baad hi detail mein samjhaya jata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Minimum Support Prices (MSP) were introduced to provide a safety net for farmers. || B. As a result, soil degradation and water depletion have become rampant in these regions. || C. However, this policy has unintentionally skewed crop patterns towards water-intensive choices. || D. Rectifying this imbalance demands a shift towards incentivizing the cultivation of millets. || E. Farmers in states like Punjab are overwhelmingly opting to grow paddy instead of pulses.
explanation: A MSP ka initial positive purpose batata hai. C 'However, this policy' use karke A ko contradict karta hai aur problem (skewed patterns) batata hai (A-C pair). E specifically C ka example deta hai ki kaise crop pattern change hue (paddy instead of pulses). B 'As a result' lagakar E wale states me water-intensive crops ugane ka environment effect batata hai (E-B pair). D finally is puri problem ka solution deta hai millets ugaane ki baat karke.
trick: B mein 'these regions' hai jo ki E ke 'states like Punjab' ko refer kar raha hai, bina uske B hawa me reh jayega.
tip: Geographical referents ('these regions') ke liye previous sentence me place dhoondo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. These sophisticated attacks can paralyze power grids and compromise critical national data. || B. Cybersecurity has evolved from an IT issue into a matter of paramount national security. || C. State-sponsored hackers are increasingly targeting the critical infrastructure of rival nations. || D. Mitigating these risks requires international cooperation and robust cyber-defense frameworks. || E. The recent ransomware attack on the central banking system perfectly illustrates this vulnerability.
explanation: B cybersecurity ko national security se jod kar topic introduce karta hai. C batata hai ki threat kahan se aa raha hai (State-sponsored hackers targeting infrastructure). A 'These sophisticated attacks' C ke hacking attempts ko bolta hai aur unka destruction level samjhata hai (C-A pair). E 'this vulnerability' use karke A me bataye destruction ka real life example deta hai. D 'Mitigating these risks' se pura issue cover karte hue conclusion deta hai.
trick: E mein 'this vulnerability' power grid aur national data compromise (A) ki baat kar raha hai. E hamesha A ke baad hi sense banayega.
tip: Real world examples hamesha theoretical dangers (A) ke baad as a proof aate hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This hawkish stance, however, often stifles immediate industrial growth. || B. To combat this prolonged inflationary pressure, the central bank decided to intervene. || C. It recently increased the repo rate by 50 basis points to absorb excess liquidity. || D. Consequently, small-scale businesses are finding it difficult to secure affordable loans. || E. Retail inflation has consistently breached the upper tolerance limit over the past three quarters.
explanation: Sentence E paragraph ka theme set karta hai ki inflation badh raha hai. B mein 'this prolonged inflationary pressure' E ke inflation ko refer karta hai (E-B pair). C mein 'It' central bank (B) ke liye use hua hai jo action (repo rate hike) bata raha hai. A mein 'This hawkish stance' C ke interest rate badhane ko point karta hai aur 'however' (halanki) lagakar negative side dikhata hai. D 'Consequently' (parinaam swaroop) ke sath A ke stifled growth ka result batata hai.
trick: 'Consequently' (D) ek result indicator hai. Isse pehle problem aani chahiye (A).
tip: 'However' negative transition dikhata hai. Usko sahi context mein place karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. These machines process information using qubits, unlike classical computers that use binary bits. || B. Furthermore, maintaining the ultra-cold temperatures required for qubits is exorbitantly expensive. || C. Quantum computing promises to solve complex problems that would take current supercomputers millennia. || D. Despite this immense potential, researchers face significant hurdles in minimizing quantum decoherence. || E. Overcoming these twin challenges is essential for their commercial viability.
explanation: C intro hai jo Quantum computing ka potential batata hai. A 'These machines' use karke C ke quantum computers ki working samjhata hai (C-A pair). D 'Despite this immense potential' (is kshamata ke bawajood) use karke C aur A ke positive tone ko contradict karta hai aur pehla hurdle lata hai. B 'Furthermore' (iske alawa) use karke doosra hurdle (expensive) add karta hai. E 'these twin challenges' (D aur B) ko solve karne ki baat karke conclude karta hai.
trick: Sentence E mein 'twin challenges' likha hai, matlab E se theek pehle 2 problems (D aur B) ka hona zaroori hai.
tip: Addition words like 'Furthermore' do similar negative/positive ideas ko jodte hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Such a system would theoretically eradicate extreme poverty and streamline welfare schemes. || B. Universal Basic Income (UBI) has gained traction as a radical solution to economic inequality. || C. On the flip side, critics argue it would severely disincentivize labor force participation. || D. Ultimately, a pilot program is necessary to empirically test these conflicting hypotheses. || E. The concept involves providing a fixed, unconditional cash transfer to every adult citizen.
explanation: B UBI ko introduce karta hai. E 'The concept' use karke UBI (B) ko define karta hai (B-E pair). A 'Such a system' bolkar E ke cash transfer ke benefits (eradicate poverty) batata hai. C 'On the flip side' (doosri taraf) use karke UBI ke negative aspects lata hai. D 'Ultimately' (ant mein) dono conflicting views (A vs C) ko test karne ka solution deta hai.
trick: 'Such a system' (A) tabhi samajh aayega jab pehle system define ho chuka ho (E).
tip: 'On the flip side' hamesha positive statement ke baad negative lata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. The carbon credit market was established to financially incentivize the reduction of greenhouse gases. || B. This loophole has allowed multinational corporations to project a false image of sustainability. || C. Instead of reducing emissions, many companies simply buy cheap credits from questionable forestry projects. || D. However, the lack of stringent global regulations has severely undermined its fundamental purpose. || E. To fix this broken system, independent auditing of carbon offset projects must be made mandatory.
explanation: A carbon credit market ka purpose batata hai. D 'However' (lekin) use karke ek broad problem (lack of regulations) lata hai jo purpose ko undermine kar rahi hai. C us problem ka specific example deta hai ki companies kya kar rahi hain. B 'This loophole' directly C ki cheap credits buy karne wali chori ko point karta hai (C-B pair). E 'this broken system' ko fix karne ka final solution deta hai.
trick: 'This loophole' (B) ka matlab chori ka raasta. Wo raasta C mein bataya gaya hai, isliye C pehle aayega.
tip: Broad general problem (D) ke baad uska specific example (C) aata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This fear of displacement is particularly strong among millions of unorganized sector workers. || B. Proponents argue that it will modernize supply chains and bring massive infrastructure investments. || C. The recent policy amendment allowing 100% Foreign Direct Investment in multi-brand retail has sparked debates. || D. Therefore, the government must draft specific safeguards to protect indigenous mom-and-pop stores. || E. Conversely, domestic traders fear that international giants will monopolize the local markets.
explanation: C main topic (FDI policy debate) start karta hai. B 'Proponents argue' bolkar pehla positive view deta hai. E 'Conversely' (iske vipreet) bolkar negative view (domestic traders ka fear) lata hai (B-E contrast pair). A 'This fear of displacement' explicitly E ke 'monopolize local markets' wale fear ko refer karta hai (E-A pair). D 'Therefore' (isliye) use karke government ko unhe protect karne ka solution deta hai.
trick: E aur B contrast pair hain. 'Conversely' (E) positive view (B) ko direct kaat-ta hai.
tip: Contrasting views hamesha ek doosre ke aas-paas (adjacent) aate hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This acute shortage paralyzed the production lines of several major automobile manufacturers. || B. Semiconductors are the microscopic brains powering almost every modern electronic device. || C. To mitigate such disruptions in the future, nations are now subsidizing domestic chip foundries. || D. The global supply chain for these critical components collapsed entirely during the pandemic lockdowns. || E. These new foundries, however, will take years to become fully operational.
explanation: B semiconductors ka introduction deta hai. D 'these critical components' se B ko link karta hai aur supply chain collapse (problem) lata hai. A 'This acute shortage' D ke collapse ka nateeja (paralyzed production) dikhata hai (D-A pair). C 'such disruptions' (A wali problem) ko future me rokne ka solution (new foundries) deta hai. E 'These new foundries' se directly C ko point karta hai aur ek warning add karta hai.
trick: 'These new foundries' (E) ko C ke 'domestic chip foundries' ka link chahiye, so C-E is mandatory.
tip: Problem aur uske effect ko sath rakho, uske baad solution laao.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Low Earth Orbit is becoming increasingly congested with thousands of defunct satellites and rocket parts. || B. Consequently, satellite operators are forced to perform expensive collision avoidance maneuvers. || C. This orbiting junkyard poses a catastrophic threat to both manned missions and active communication satellites. || D. Addressing this looming crisis requires an international treaty to actively remove defunct space hardware. || E. Even a minor collision at orbital velocities can generate a dangerous cloud of shrapnel.
explanation: A main problem introduce karta hai (congested orbit). C 'This orbiting junkyard' A ke 'defunct satellites and rocket parts' ko denote karta hai (A-C pair). E batata hai ki threat kaisa hai (minor collision = shrapnel). B 'Consequently' (iske nateejan) use karke batata hai ki E aur C ke dar ke karan operators ko kya karna padta hai. D 'Addressing this looming crisis' se final global solution deta hai.
trick: Students B ko jaldi laga sakte hain, par B ka action (maneuvers) E ki collision ki probability samajhne ke baad hi aayega.
tip: 'This' + noun combination is the best tool to find the preceding sentence.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This mass exodus deprives the developing nation of its most skilled and innovative workforce. || B. Developing countries heavily subsidize higher education to build a robust foundation of human capital. || C. Moreover, the loss of tax revenue from these high-earning individuals hampers domestic infrastructure growth. || D. Unfortunately, many top graduates immediately migrate to Western countries in search of better opportunities. || E. To reverse this trend, local governments must cultivate a thriving ecosystem of research and competitive salaries.
explanation: B start karta hai ki kaise countries education subsidize karti hain. D 'Unfortunately' (durbhagya se) use karke effort waste hone ki baat (brain drain) lata hai. A 'This mass exodus' D ke migration process ko bolta hai aur pehla bada nuksan batata hai. C 'Moreover' (iske atirikt) use karke doosra nuksan (tax loss) add karta hai. E 'To reverse this trend' bolkar conclude aur resolve karta hai.
trick: A mein 'exodus' (bade paimane par logo ka jana) word D ke 'migrate' ka synonym/result hai. So D-A banega.
tip: 'Moreover' hamesha same idea mein ek aur naya point add karta hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This decentralized architecture makes it notoriously difficult for central authorities to track illicit transactions. || B. Cryptocurrencies operate on decentralized blockchain networks, completely bypassing traditional banking intermediaries. || C. Global financial watchdogs are increasingly concerned about the rampant use of digital assets in money laundering. || D. Therefore, a globally coordinated regulatory framework is crucial to monitor cross-border crypto flows. || E. Criminal syndicates exploit this anonymity to effortlessly funnel funds across international borders.
explanation: C broad concern (money laundering) start karta hai. B explain karta hai ki crypto kaam kaise karta hai. A 'This decentralized architecture' directly B ke 'decentralized blockchain' ko refer karta hai (B-A pair). E 'this anonymity' A ke 'difficult to track' feature ko refer karta hai aur batata hai criminals iska fayda kaise uthate hain (A-E pair). D 'Therefore' (ataha) ke sath final regulatory solution deta hai.
trick: E mein 'this anonymity' hai. Anonymity ka concept A me 'difficult to track' se aata hai. Bina A ke E nahi aayega.
tip: Paragraph ke flow ko samjho: Issue -> Concept -> Feature -> Misuse -> Solution.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Artificial Intelligence has drastically lowered the technical barrier required to create hyper-realistic altered videos. || B. Such synthetic media can be weaponized to manipulate public opinion and defame political candidates. || C. To counter this threat, tech giants are frantically developing algorithmic detection tools. || D. These manipulated videos, commonly known as deepfakes, are becoming virtually indistinguishable from reality. || E. However, these defensive tools are currently lagging behind the rapidly evolving generation technologies.
explanation: A deepfakes create hone ka reason (AI) batata hai. D 'These manipulated videos' directly A ke 'altered videos' ko refer karke unko 'deepfakes' ka naam deta hai (A-D pair). B 'Such synthetic media' D ke deepfakes ko refer karta hai aur unka khatra (weaponized) batata hai. C 'this threat' (B ki manipulation) ko solve karne ka tareeqa (detection tools) lata hai. E 'However' (tathapi) se un tools (C) ki weakness batakar conclude karta hai.
trick: A aur D mandatory hain. D 'deepfakes' define karta hai, aur B 'Such synthetic media' se usko refer karta hai.
tip: Pronouns like 'Such' mostly previous sentence mein define hui cheez ko point karte hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This calcification failure disrupts the entire marine food web, threatening global fisheries. || B. The world's oceans act as massive carbon sinks, absorbing roughly a quarter of all human-made CO2 emissions. || C. While this absorption mitigates atmospheric warming, it fundamentally alters marine chemistry. || D. Preserving marine biodiversity thus hinges on immediately curbing our global reliance on fossil fuels. || E. The resulting ocean acidification severely impairs the ability of corals and mollusks to build their shells.
explanation: B start karta hai batakar ki oceans carbon absorb karte hain. C 'this absorption' se B ko link karta hai aur ek problem (alters marine chemistry) introduce karta hai. E 'The resulting ocean acidification' C ke chemical alteration ka asar batata hai (shell-building fail hona). A 'This calcification failure' directly E ke shell-building failure ko describe karta hai (E-A pair). D 'thus' laga kar final solution deta hai.
trick: E me 'acidification' chemical reaction hai (C), aur A me 'calcification' E ke 'build shells' ki process hai. Inka order C-E-A strict hai.
tip: Scientific terms unke layman explanation ke theek baad aate hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. The gig economy has democratized freelance work, offering unprecedented flexibility to millions of independent contractors. || B. Furthermore, the lack of medical insurance leaves the workers highly vulnerable during health emergencies. || C. This misclassification allows platform aggregators to legally circumvent minimum wage laws and paid leave mandates. || D. However, these aggregators deliberately classify these workers as independent partners rather than employees. || E. Correcting this systematic exploitation requires urgent legislative intervention.
explanation: A gig economy ka positive point (flexibility) batata hai. D 'However' (parantu) se contrast banata hai ki workers ko manipulate karke 'independent partners' classify kiya jata hai. C 'This misclassification' (galat category me daalna) directly D ke action ko point karta hai aur pehla loss batata hai. B 'Furthermore' (iske aage) se doosra loss (no medical insurance) add karta hai. E saare problems ko 'systematic exploitation' bolkar solve karne ki demand karta hai.
trick: D aur C ka link bohot solid hai. 'Independent partners rather than employees' yahi wo 'misclassification' hai jo C me hai.
tip: Identify the core problem first, then read its negative impacts in order.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This complex ecosystem plays a pivotal role in digestion, immunity, and even mental health. || B. The human digestive tract hosts trillions of microorganisms, collectively known as the gut microbiome. || C. As a result, an unhealthy gut flora has been heavily linked to chronic diseases like obesity. || D. Restoring microbial balance often requires a sustained diet rich in prebiotics and fermented foods. || E. Conversely, highly processed foods and reckless antibiotic usage can decimate these beneficial bacterial colonies.
explanation: B gut microbiome ko define karta hai. A 'This complex ecosystem' se B ke microbiome ki importance batata hai (B-A pair). E 'Conversely' (iske ulat) use karke batata hai ki buri aadatain kaise in colonies ko barbaad karti hain. C 'As a result' (parinaam swaroop) E ka direct effect dikhata hai ki barbaad hone se bimari lagti hai. D in bimariyon se bachne ke liye balance restore karne ka solution deta hai.
trick: E 'Conversely' negative tone laata hai. Uski madad se positive ecosystem (A) destroy hota hai, aur fir disease (C) aati hai.
tip: 'As a result' hamesha immediate cause ke baad aayega (Yaha E cause hai).

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This demographic shift presents unprecedented fiscal challenges for many industrialized nations. || B. Consequently, governments are being forced to raise the retirement age to sustain these funds. || C. Thanks to advancements in medical science, global life expectancy has increased dramatically over the last century. || D. Such unpopular policy decisions often trigger widespread protests among the working-class population. || E. Specifically, a shrinking working-age population struggles to generate enough tax revenue to support bloated pension systems.
explanation: C intro hai (life expectancy badh rahi hai). A 'This demographic shift' C ke badhte old logo ko point karta hai aur broad challenges ka zikar karta hai (C-A pair). E 'Specifically' lagakar A ke challenge ko detail mein batata hai (tax/pension problem). B 'Consequently' (isliye) lagakar problem solve karne ki government ki koshish (raise retirement age) batata hai. D 'Such unpopular policy' B ke retirement age badhane wale decision ko point karke protests batata hai.
trick: Sentence B ka 'these funds' directly E ke 'pension systems' ko point karta hai, isliye E ke baad B aayega.
tip: Macro level sentence (A) ke theek baad uska micro level detail (E) aata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Non-Performing Assets (NPAs) act as silent parasites, slowly draining the vitality of the banking sector. || B. This hesitation severely starves critical infrastructure projects of the necessary credit flow. || C. When corporate borrowers default on massive loans, banks are forced to drastically increase their provisioning. || D. Ultimately, a state-sponsored 'bad bank' might be the only viable mechanism to clean up these toxic balance sheets. || E. Consequently, to protect their shrinking profit margins, banks become extremely risk-averse in lending.
explanation: A NPAs ko introduce karta hai aur bank sector ki draining ki baat karta hai. C NPAs create hone ka process (defaulting) batata hai aur bank ke provisioning ka reaction lata hai. E 'Consequently' (iske fal-swaroop) C ka result hai, jahan provisioning se profit kam hota hai aur bank risk-averse (darpok) ban jata hai (C-E pair). B 'This hesitation' E ke risk-averse behavior ko point karta hai aur infrastructure suffer karta hai batata hai. D final solution deta hai.
trick: B me 'This hesitation' (hichkichahat) hai, jo ki E ke 'risk-averse' hone ka dusra naam hai. Isliye E-B ek joda banega.
tip: Banking/Economic passages me cause aur uske chain of effects dhyan se follow karo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This seamless virtual universe promises to revolutionize how we work, socialize, and consume entertainment. || B. The Metaverse envisions a highly immersive internet where physical and digital realities converge. || C. These sensory limitations currently prevent the concept from achieving true mainstream adoption. || D. To access this realm, users currently rely on clunky Virtual Reality headsets. || E. Moreover, persistent concerns regarding data privacy cast a long shadow over its future.
explanation: B Metaverse ko define karta hai. A 'This seamless virtual universe' B ko refer karta hai aur positive potential batata hai (B-A pair). D 'this realm' ko access karne ki baat karta hai jo ki A ke baad natural flow hai, lekin yahan 'clunky headsets' ki kami batata hai. C 'These sensory limitations' directly D ke 'clunky headsets' wale experience ko point karta hai (D-C pair). E 'Moreover' (iske sath hi) privacy ki ek nayi problem add karke conclusion karta hai.
trick: C mein 'These sensory limitations' hain. Virtual reality headsets (D) hi sensory interface hote hain. D aur C hamesha sath aayenge.
tip: Hardware device (D) aur uski limitation (C) hamesha logical pairs hote hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. For instance, scientists have successfully edited wheat genomes to resist devastating fungal rusts. || B. This specific breakthrough could prevent massive crop failures and ensure global food security. || C. Climate change is rapidly accelerating the incidence of severe droughts and novel plant diseases. || D. Despite these successes, strict regulatory hurdles in Europe prevent the commercial cultivation of such crops. || E. To combat this agricultural crisis, researchers are leveraging CRISPR-Cas9 gene-editing technology.
explanation: C problem (plant diseases/droughts) batata hai. E 'this agricultural crisis' (C ki problem) ko solve karne ke liye CRISPR technique lata hai. A 'For instance' (udaharan ke liye) CRISPR ka ek successful wheat genome edit example deta hai. B 'This specific breakthrough' completely A ke wheat editing ko refer karta hai aur uske fayde batata hai (A-B pair). D 'Despite these successes' (in safaltaon ke bawajood) se regulatory block laga kar paragraph conclude karta hai.
trick: B 'This specific breakthrough' ko E se jodna galat hoga. E general technology hai, A specific breakthrough hai. So A-B correct hai.
tip: 'For instance' example hamesha broad theory sentence ke baad hi set hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Historically, women have been grossly underrepresented in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) fields. || B. This chronic lack of mentorship makes it difficult for young female professionals to navigate corporate ladders. || C. While university enrollment rates for women in STEM have improved, a 'leaky pipeline' phenomenon persists. || D. Consequently, a significant percentage abandon their technical careers mid-way. || E. To plug this leak, tech companies must actively foster inclusive environments and sponsor female leadership programs.
explanation: A STEM mein women ki underrepresentation (main topic) batata hai. C kehta hai ki although padhai mein number badha hai, but ek 'leaky pipeline' (mid-career chhodna) hai. B 'This chronic lack of mentorship' us pipeline leak ka primary karan batata hai. D 'Consequently' (jiske parinaam swaroop) batata hai ki B ki wajah se auratein career chhod deti hain, jo C ki 'leaky pipeline' ko further prove karta hai. E 'To plug this leak' final solution deta hai.
trick: Sentence E 'plug this leak' bolta hai. Matlap solution. Aur leak start C me hota hai, process B me, result D me. So C-B-D-E flow banega.
tip: Problem ko pehle describe karo (C, B), fir uski urgency (D) dikhao, end me fix (E).

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This abundant liquidity led venture capitalists to assign astronomical valuations to loss-making startups. || B. The post-pandemic era witnessed an unprecedented influx of cheap capital into the financial markets. || C. As a result, many celebrated unicorns faced brutal down-rounds and massive employee layoffs. || D. Restoring investor confidence will require a fundamental return to sustainable, profit-driven business models. || E. However, as global central banks aggressively hiked interest rates, this funding bubble abruptly burst.
explanation: B post-pandemic era ki cheap capital/liquidity ke baare mein batata hai. A 'This abundant liquidity' B ki capital ko refer karke uska asar (astronomical valuations) batata hai (B-A pair). E 'However' (parantu) se interest rates hike hone se is bubble ke phatne ki negative news lata hai. C 'As a result' (iske chalte) bubble burst hone (E) ka effect batata hai ki startups ne logo ko fire kiya. D aage ka forward-looking solution deta hai.
trick: Sentence C ka result (layoffs) tabhi aayega jab bubble phatega (E). Isliye E-C aayega.
tip: 'Bubble burst' aam taur par extreme valuations (A) ke baad ka turning point (E) hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Such deceptive tactics mislead eco-conscious consumers into paying a premium for ordinary products. || B. Furthermore, it diverts crucial capital away from genuinely sustainable and ethical enterprises. || C. 'Greenwashing' is a marketing gimmick used by companies to falsely exaggerate their environmental efforts. || D. A classic example is slapping a '100% natural' label on cosmetics packed with harmful synthetic chemicals. || E. Combating this corporate hypocrisy requires stringent truth-in-advertising laws backed by heavy financial penalties.
explanation: C 'Greenwashing' term ko define karta hai. D uska ek solid 'classic example' deta hai (labeling fake naturals). A 'Such deceptive tactics' D ke fraud labeling ko refer karta hai aur uska consumer impact batata hai (D-A pair). B 'Furthermore' (aur toh aur) se capital diversion ka doosra bada problem add karta hai. E 'this corporate hypocrisy' (jo A aur B me dikhai di) ko thik karne ka law-based solution deta hai.
trick: A mein 'deceptive tactics' general hai par usko point karne ke liye D jaisa clear deceptive example zaroori hai. Toh D-A joda banta hai.
tip: Definition (C) ke immediately baad uska supporting example (D) aana chahiye.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. The central bank recently introduced a pilot program for its sovereign digital currency. || B. These technical challenges could potentially derail the entire digitization initiative. || C. However, moving from a pilot to a full-scale launch presents severe technical challenges. || D. To prevent this, massive investments in secure server infrastructure are urgently required. || E. This virtual currency is designed to significantly reduce the operational costs of cash management.
explanation: Sentence A intro hai jisme 'sovereign digital currency' ki baat ki gayi hai. E mein 'This virtual currency' directly A ko refer karta hai aur uska positive purpose (reduce cost) batata hai (A-E pair). C 'However' (halanki) use karke contrast lata hai aur 'technical challenges' introduce karta hai. B ka 'These technical challenges' directly C ko point out karta hai (C-B pair). D 'To prevent this' (ise rokne ke liye) bolkar B wale derailment (fail hone) ko rokne ka solution deta hai.
trick: Sentence B mein 'These technical challenges' hai, aur C 'technical challenges' pe khatam hota hai. C ke turant baad B aayega.
tip: Demonstrative pronouns ('These') se theek pehle unka noun aana chahiye.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Despite its high accuracy, the algorithm occasionally misinterprets rare anomalies. || B. Artificial Intelligence is revolutionizing the field of medical radiology. || C. Such diagnostic errors can lead to devastating consequences for the patients. || D. It achieves this by rapidly analyzing thousands of complex X-ray images. || E. Therefore, human oversight remains absolutely mandatory in final clinical decisions.
explanation: B ek broad intro hai AI in radiology par. D mein 'It achieves this' us revolution (B) ki process batata hai ki AI ye kaise karta hai (B-D pair). A 'Despite' (ke bawajood) use karke D ki high accuracy ke baad ek kami (misinterprets anomalies) batata hai. C 'Such diagnostic errors' A ke misinterpretation ko point karta hai aur uska nateeja batata hai (A-C pair). E 'Therefore' (isliye) use karke final solution deta hai ki doctors zaroori hain.
trick: A aur C solid pair hain kyunki C ka 'diagnostic errors', A ke 'misinterprets' ka hi doosra naam hai.
tip: Paragraph ka structure hamesha: Intro -> Mechanism -> Flaw -> Effect -> Solution hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Furthermore, they are deprived of basic health insurance and paid leave. || B. The platform-based gig economy offers unprecedented flexibility to modern workers. || C. This severe misclassification demands immediate intervention from labor welfare boards. || D. Conversely, it systematically strips them of traditional employment benefits by classifying them as 'partners'. || E. This lack of a safety net leaves the workers highly vulnerable during emergencies.
explanation: B positive side (flexibility) batakar intro deta hai. D 'Conversely' (iske ulat) use karke negative side lata hai ki unko benefits nahi milte aur unhe 'partners' bola jata hai (B-D pair). A 'Furthermore' (aur toh aur) se D ki baat mein ek aur point add karta hai (no health insurance). E 'This lack of a safety net' direct A ke health insurance na hone ko refer karta hai (A-E pair). C finally solution mangta hai in sab problems ke liye.
trick: D mein 'Conversely' hai jo B ke flexibility (positive) ko benefits strip karne (negative) se contradict karta hai.
tip: 'Conversely' opposite ideas ko connect karne ka sabse strong indicator hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This warming fundamentally alters global atmospheric circulation patterns. || B. Consequently, we are witnessing an exponential rise in extreme weather events like flash floods. || C. The unabated burning of fossil fuels continues to trap heat in the earth's atmosphere. || D. These unpredictable events wreak havoc on vulnerable agricultural economies. || E. Mitigating this massive economic damage requires building climate-resilient infrastructure.
explanation: C global warming ka basic cause (burning fuels) batata hai. A 'This warming' use karke C ke heat trap hone ke process ka scientific effect batata hai (C-A pair). B 'Consequently' (parinaam swaroop) use karke A wale pattern change ka real-life result (extreme weather) dikhata hai. D 'These unpredictable events' seedha B ke 'extreme weather events' ko point karta hai aur uska economic damage batata hai. E end mein 'this massive economic damage' (D) ko fix karne ka solution deta hai.
trick: B aur D ka relation samjho. D 'unpredictable events' bolta hai, aur B mein wo event 'flash floods' ke roop mein defined hai. B hamesha D se pehle aayega.
tip: Logical flow: Cause (C) -> Scientific Effect (A) -> Physical Effect (B) -> Economic Effect (D) -> Solution (E).

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This massive accumulation severely restricts the lending capacity of these financial institutions. || B. Public sector banks are struggling with a mountain of Non-Performing Assets (NPAs). || C. To clean up these toxic balance sheets, the government has established a 'Bad Bank'. || D. As a result, critical infrastructure projects are starved of necessary credit flow. || E. This newly formed entity will purchase the defaulted loans at a discounted rate.
explanation: B NPAs ka problem introduce karta hai. A 'This massive accumulation' use karke B ke 'mountain of NPAs' ko refer karta hai aur bank ki lending problem batata hai (B-A pair). D 'As a result' (iske fal-swaroop) bank ki restricted lending (A) ka negative asar (infrastructure starving) batata hai. C 'toxic balance sheets' (A/D ki wajah se) ko saaf karne ka solution ('Bad Bank') lata hai. E 'This newly formed entity' completely C ke 'Bad Bank' ko point karta hai (C-E pair).
trick: E mein 'newly formed entity' hai. Yeh government ka banaya hua 'Bad Bank' (C) hai. So, C aur E pakke dost hain.
tip: Noun phrases ('newly formed entity') unke proper nouns ('Bad Bank') ke baad aate hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This revolutionary standard promises ultra-low latency and gigabit internet speeds. || B. However, setting up the dense network of small cells requires enormous capital expenditure. || C. Telecom operators are aggressively rolling out 5G services across major metropolitan areas. || D. Recouping these massive investments will inevitably lead to a sharp hike in tariff plans. || E. Such increased costs could widen the digital divide between urban and rural populations.
explanation: C start karta hai ki 5G rollout ho raha hai. A 'This revolutionary standard' se 5G (C) ke fayde batata hai (C-A pair). B 'However' (halanki) use karke 5G setup karne ki problem (enormous expenditure) lata hai. D 'these massive investments' use karke B ke kharche ko recover (recoup) karne ke liye tariff hike ka plan batata hai (B-D pair). E 'Such increased costs' directly D ke 'hike in tariff plans' ko point karke final negative conclusion deta hai.
trick: D me 'massive investments' B ke 'capital expenditure' ka synonym hai. Lexical linking se B ke turant baad D aayega.
tip: 'However' shift of tone lata hai. Fayde (A) khatam, nuksaan (B) shuru.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This precise editing capability holds the key to curing inherited genetic disorders. || B. CRISPR technology acts as molecular scissors that can cut and alter DNA sequences. || C. Moreover, modifying human embryos could lead to irreversible evolutionary consequences. || D. Despite its clinical promise, the technology raises profound ethical dilemmas. || E. These terrifying possibilities necessitate a globally enforced moratorium on germline editing.
explanation: B CRISPR ko define karta hai. A 'This precise editing capability' se B ki definition (cut and alter DNA) ko link karta hai aur uska fayda batata hai (B-A pair). D 'Despite its clinical promise' (isko faayde ke bawajood) use karke tone change karta hai aur ethical dilemma (khatra) lata hai. C 'Moreover' (iske atirikt) se ek aur bada khatra (embryo modification) add karta hai. E 'These terrifying possibilities' (C aur D ke khatre) ko rokne ke liye ek ban (moratorium) ka solution deta hai.
trick: Sentence D me 'clinical promise' word A ke 'curing disorders' ko represent karta hai, isliye D hamesha A ke baad aayega.
tip: 'Moreover' use tab hota hai jab same tone (yahan negative) mein koi doosra point jodna ho.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. These essential commodities form the core of the average household's monthly budget. || B. Retail inflation has persistently hovered above the central bank's tolerance band. || C. Consequently, the purchasing power of the middle class has severely eroded. || D. This prolonged inflationary pressure is primarily driven by soaring food and fuel prices. || E. Taming this persistent inflation requires urgent supply-side structural reforms.
explanation: B inflation problem ko introduce karta hai. D 'This prolonged inflationary pressure' bolkar B ko refer karta hai aur inflation ka karan (food and fuel) batata hai (B-D pair). A 'These essential commodities' seedha D ke 'food and fuel' ko point karta hai (D-A pair). C 'Consequently' (iske nateejan) batata hai ki A ki wajah se aam aadmi garib ho raha hai (purchasing power eroded). E solution deta hai is inflation ko tame (control) karne ka.
trick: A me 'These essential commodities' likha hai. Agar aap A ko pehle laga doge toh samajh nahi aayega ki kaunsi commodities. Pehle D me food aur fuel batao.
tip: Har pronoun ('These') ke pehle uska antecedent noun dhoondhna zaroori hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This ambitious framework aims to shift the focus from rote memorization to critical thinking. || B. The new National Education Policy (NEP) promises a radical overhaul of the schooling system. || C. Furthermore, a severe shortage of trained teachers threatens to derail the entire initiative. || D. However, executing such a massive pedagogical shift requires exceptional state-level coordination. || E. Bridging these critical resource gaps must be the primary focus of the education ministry.
explanation: B NEP introduce karta hai. A 'This ambitious framework' B ke NEP ko bolta hai aur uska aim batata hai (B-A pair). D 'However' (halanki) use karke is aim ko implement karne ka pehla challenge (coordination) batata hai. C 'Furthermore' (iske alawa) use karke doosra bada challenge (teacher shortage) add karta hai. E 'these critical resource gaps' (jo C me bataye gaye hain) ko bridge karne ki salah deta hai.
trick: C me 'Furthermore' hai. Yeh tabhi aayega jab pehle koi issue (D me coordination) bata diya gaya ho. D ke baad C aayega.
tip: Positive start ke baad negative point laane ke liye hamesha contrast word ('However') dhoondo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This strategic exit aims to reduce the fiscal burden on the central exchequer. || B. The government has aggressively pushed for the privatization of loss-making public enterprises. || C. On the other hand, labor unions argue it will lead to massive job losses. || D. Balancing these fiscal ambitions with social security remains a delicate political tightrope. || E. Such widespread unemployment could trigger severe socio-economic unrest in developing regions.
explanation: B privatization ka topic start karta hai. A 'This strategic exit' directly B ke privatization process ko refer karta hai aur uska reason (reduce fiscal burden) batata hai (B-A pair). C 'On the other hand' (doosri taraf) use karke A ke fayde ko labor unions ke dar (job losses) se contradict karta hai. E 'Such widespread unemployment' C ke 'job losses' ko point karta hai aur uska result (unrest) batata hai (C-E pair). D end me fiscal ambitions (A) aur social security (C/E) ko balance karne ko bolkar paragraph wrap karta hai.
trick: D me 'these fiscal ambitions' A se aata hai, aur 'social security' C se aata hai. Isliye D hamesha dono views ke baad aayega.
tip: Conclusion sentence me generally pehle discuss hue dono opposing views ka summary hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This invisible tracking allows tech giants to build highly lucrative behavioral profiles. || B. Free smartphone applications routinely harvest massive amounts of personal user data. || C. Consequently, targeted advertising has become a multi-billion dollar global industry. || D. To curb this rampant exploitation, comprehensive data protection laws are urgently needed. || E. However, these stringent laws often face fierce lobbying from the corporate sector.
explanation: B data harvesting ka point lata hai. A 'This invisible tracking' B ke data harvest process ko bolta hai aur profiles banne ki baat karta hai (B-A pair). C 'Consequently' (isliye/nateejan) A wale profile data ka effect batata hai ki targeted advertising ek badi industry ban gayi hai. D 'this rampant exploitation' (jo B, A aur C me hua) ko rokne ke liye laws (laws) lata hai. E 'However' (halanki) use karke un laws ke pass hone ka hurdle (corporate lobbying) batata hai.
trick: E me 'these stringent laws' hai, jo definitely D ke 'data protection laws' ko refer karta hai. D aur E sath rahenge.
tip: 'Consequently' intermediate effect dikhata hai, jabki 'Therefore' mostly final conclusion lata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This critical component heavily relies on the mining of rare earth metals like lithium. || B. Electric Vehicles (EVs) are widely championed as the ultimate solution to vehicular pollution. || C. Such intensive mining operations often cause severe ecological degradation in developing countries. || D. Addressing this paradox requires investing heavily in battery recycling technologies. || E. However, the environmental sustainability of their battery production remains highly questionable.
explanation: B EVs ko positive light me introduce karta hai. E 'However' (halanki) use karke EV ke battery production ki sustainability par sawal uthata hai (B-E contrast pair). A 'This critical component' E ki 'battery' ko point karke lithium mining ka zikar karta hai (E-A pair). C 'Such intensive mining operations' directly A ke lithium mining se link karta hai aur ecological damage batata hai. D 'this paradox' (EV pollution rokte hain but mining pollution karti hai) ko battery recycling se solve karne ko bolta hai.
trick: B aur E ke baad A aayega. A me 'critical component' seedha E ki battery ko refer kar raha hai. EV ko nahi.
tip: 'Paradox' ka matlab uljhan ya virodhabhas. Yeh hamesha 2 opposing statements (EV achha hai vs EV ki battery buri hai) ke baad aata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This incredible capability allows astronomers to peer through thick clouds of cosmic dust. || B. The James Webb Space Telescope operates primarily in the infrared spectrum of light. || C. By doing so, it can capture the faint light from the universe's earliest galaxies. || D. Analyzing these ancient photons will fundamentally alter our understanding of cosmic evolution. || E. Prior to this launch, such deep-space observations were considered technologically impossible.
explanation: B James Webb Telescope aur uski 'infrared spectrum' technology introduce karta hai. A 'This incredible capability' directly B ke infrared operation ko point karta hai aur uska use (dust peer karna) batata hai (B-A pair). C 'By doing so' (aisa karke) A ka next step batata hai ki dust ke paar dekhne se early galaxies ka light milta hai. D 'these ancient photons' seedha C ke 'faint light' ko refer karta hai (C-D pair). E ek broad conclusion deta hai ki isse pehle yeh sab impossible tha.
trick: Students C aur D me confuse hote hain. C ka 'light' D me jaakar 'photons' (light particles) ban jata hai. Vocabulary ka direct link hai.
tip: Scientific concepts ko chronological action (process) ke hisaab se arrange karo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This populist culture of distributing unbudgeted freebies severely strains state finances. || B. Political parties often promise irrational freebies to woo voters ahead of crucial elections. || C. Consequently, the state is left with zero capital to invest in vital infrastructure. || D. To halt this fiscal ruin, the election commission must enforce strict spending guidelines. || E. Such reckless expenditure forces the government to borrow heavily from the open market.
explanation: B elections aur freebies ka base set karta hai. A 'This populist culture' B ki freebie culture ko point karke state finance par strain (load) batata hai (B-A pair). E 'Such reckless expenditure' A wale strain ko aage badhata hai ki sarkar ko udhaar (borrow) lena padta hai. C 'Consequently' (parinaam swaroop) batata hai ki udhaar aur kharche ke karan infrastructure ke liye zero capital bachta hai. D 'this fiscal ruin' ko rokne ke liye guidelines ka final solution lata hai.
trick: A aur E me farq samjho. A overall tension (strain) batata hai, E us tension ko manage karne ka galat tareeqa (borrowing) batata hai. Sequence A->E banega.
tip: Financial cause and effect dhyan rakho: Freebies -> Strain -> Borrowing -> Zero Capital.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This concrete expansion has systematically destroyed natural drainage systems and wetlands. || B. Rapid and unplanned urbanization is transforming our metropolitan cities into concrete jungles. || C. Reclaiming these lost ecological spaces is the only sustainable solution to this crisis. || D. Consequently, even a moderate spell of monsoon rain triggers devastating urban floods. || E. These recurrent floods paralyze economic activity and cause immense property damage.
explanation: B urbanization ko introduce karke cities ko 'concrete jungles' bolta hai. A 'This concrete expansion' directly B ke 'concrete jungles' concept ko point karta hai aur drainage destruction batata hai (B-A pair). D 'Consequently' (iske nateejan) batata hai ki drainage tutne (A) se floods aate hain. E 'These recurrent floods' seedha D ke 'urban floods' ko refer karta hai aur unka destruction level samjhata hai (D-E pair). C end me lost spaces (A wale wetlands) ko reclaim karne ka solution deta hai.
trick: D me floods aate hain, aur E me floods ka impact hai. Hamesha event pehle aayega, impact baad me.
tip: 'This' lagakar repeated words dhoondo (Concrete jungles -> This concrete expansion).

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This decentralized and anonymous nature makes them highly susceptible to money laundering. || B. Cryptocurrencies operate outside the regulatory purview of traditional central banking systems. || C. Therefore, a globally synchronized regulatory framework is essential to track cross-border transactions. || D. Such illegal financial activities pose a grave threat to national security. || E. Furthermore, terror outfits frequently exploit these networks to fund their operations.
explanation: B cryptocurrency ke operation (outside regulation) ko introduce karta hai. A 'This decentralized and anonymous nature' directly B ko refer karta hai aur pehla threat (money laundering) lata hai (B-A pair). E 'Furthermore' (aur toh aur) se doosra bada threat (terror funding) add karta hai. D 'Such illegal financial activities' dono threat (A aur E) ko combine karke national security ka risk batata hai. C 'Therefore' (isliye) lagakar global regulation ka conclusion deta hai.
trick: D me 'illegal activities' (plural) hai, jo ki money laundering (A) aur terror funding (E) dono ko mila kar banta hai. Isliye D, E ke baad aayega.
tip: 'Furthermore' se hum multiple examples (A and E) ikathe karke fir ek broad noun (D) se refer kar sakte hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This financial incentive was supposed to aggressively drive down global corporate emissions. || B. The carbon credit market allows companies to buy and sell permits to emit carbon dioxide. || C. Such deceptive practices are commonly referred to as corporate greenwashing. || D. However, many corporations simply buy cheap credits instead of upgrading their polluting technologies. || E. Eradicating this loophole requires strict international audits of all carbon offset projects.
explanation: B carbon credit market ki definition se start karta hai. A 'This financial incentive' us market (B) ka original positive aim batata hai (B-A pair). D 'However' (halanki) use karke contrast lata hai ki companies actual me cheating ('buy cheap credits') kar rahi hain, emissions kam nahi kar rahin. C 'Such deceptive practices' D wali cheating ko 'greenwashing' ka naam deta hai (D-C pair). E is problem ko ek 'loophole' bolkar usko fix karne ka audit solution deta hai.
trick: D me cheating aayi hai aur C usko 'deceptive practice' bolta hai. C bina D ke use ho hi nahi sakta.
tip: Definition hamesha action se pehle aati hai. Greenwashing ka action (D) uski definition (C) se pehle aayega.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This massive inflow of foreign capital aims to boost domestic manufacturing capabilities. || B. The government has recently liberalized Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) norms across multiple sectors. || C. Conversely, local MSMEs fear they will be completely wiped out by aggressive multinational giants. || D. Protecting these vulnerable domestic players requires a robust antitrust regulatory mechanism. || E. Such a monumental collapse of local businesses could lead to an unprecedented employment crisis.
explanation: B FDI liberalize karne ki policy introduce karta hai. A 'This massive inflow' B ke FDI ko point karke policy ka positive aim batata hai. C 'Conversely' (iske vipreet) use karke local businesses ka dar (negative side) dikhata hai ki wo wipe out ho jayenge (B/A-C contrast). E 'Such a monumental collapse' seedha C ke 'wiped out' hone ke dar ko badha-chadhakar unemployment crisis ka nateeja batata hai (C-E pair). D solution deta hai in local players (C aur E) ko protect karne ka.
trick: C aur E me flow pakdo. C bolta hai MSME khatam ho jayenge. E uske aage ka effect batata hai ki khatam hue to berozgari aayegi. Sequence C->E.
tip: 'Conversely' ekdum 180-degree shift karta hai (Positive to Negative).

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This quantum state allows them to process multiple possibilities simultaneously. || B. Quantum computers leverage the bizarre principles of subatomic physics to perform complex calculations. || C. Overcoming this thermal challenge is the biggest hurdle for commercial quantum computing. || D. Consequently, they can crack complex cryptographic codes in a matter of mere seconds. || E. However, maintaining these delicate quantum states requires cooling the processors to near absolute zero.
explanation: B quantum computing ka introduction deta hai. A 'This quantum state' B ke principles ko explain karta hai ki yeh kaise multiple possibilities process karta hai (B-A pair). D 'Consequently' (isliye) A ke simultaneous process ka ek practical power (cracking codes) batata hai. E 'However' (halanki) us power ke baad ek limitation lata hai ki inhe absolute zero par cool rakhna padta hai. C 'this thermal challenge' seedha E ki cooling requirement ko refer karta hai (E-C pair).
trick: E aur C ka mandatory pair hai kyunki C me 'thermal challenge' hai aur E cooling (absolute zero) ki baat kar raha hai.
tip: Scientific problems ('thermal challenge') apne respective mechanism ('cooling') ke baad hi discuss kiye jaate hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This unconditional cash transfer aims to provide a fundamental safety net against extreme poverty. || B. Universal Basic Income (UBI) proposes a periodic payment delivered to all citizens. || C. Addressing these valid concerns is absolutely essential before implementing such a colossal welfare scheme. || D. On the flip side, critics argue that it would severely disincentivize the working-class population. || E. Such a massive drop in workforce participation could trigger a severe economic recession.
explanation: B UBI ki definition deta hai (periodic payment). A 'This unconditional cash transfer' us payment (B) ka positive goal (safety net) batata hai (B-A pair). D 'On the flip side' (doosri taraf) use karke positive goal ke against ek criticism lata hai (disincentivize working class). E 'Such a massive drop in workforce participation' D ke working class ki interest lose karne ko detail karta hai ki isse recession aayega. C 'Addressing these valid concerns' (jo D aur E me aaye) ko solve karne ke baad hi scheme implement karne ki baat karta hai.
trick: Sentence D aur E aapas me closely linked hain. E ka 'massive drop' D ke 'disincentivize' hone ka direct asar hai.
tip: 'On the flip side' is a conversational way to introduce a counter-argument.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This sudden depreciation makes imported crude oil significantly more expensive for the domestic market. || B. The global geopolitical tensions have triggered a massive flight of capital toward safe-haven assets. || C. Consequently, the central bank is forced to intervene by selling its precious foreign exchange reserves. || D. To offset this widening trade deficit, the government must heavily incentivize indigenous renewable energy projects. || E. As a direct result of this capital flight, emerging market currencies are experiencing steep depreciations.
explanation: B paragraph start karta hai global geopolitical tension aur 'capital flight' se. E mein 'this capital flight' seedha B ko point karta hai aur uska asar (currency depreciation) batata hai (B-E pair). A mein 'This sudden depreciation' E ki depreciation ko refer karta hai aur crude oil ka expensive hona batata hai. C 'Consequently' (parinaam swaroop) use karke batata hai ki A ki wajah se central bank ko reserves bechne padte hain. D 'this widening trade deficit' ko offset karne ka final macroeconomic solution deta hai.
trick: Sentence A me 'depreciation' word E se aaya hai. Bina E ke A ko samajhna impossible hai, isliye E hamesha A se pehle aayega.
tip: 'This' + Noun (This capital flight) hamesha previous sentence ke concept ko pakadta hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This targeted application drastically reduces the amount of chemical runoff entering nearby water bodies. || B. Drones are rapidly transforming traditional agricultural practices across the developing world. || C. Despite these ecological benefits, the high initial cost of these devices deters small-scale farmers. || D. Subsidizing this technology is therefore crucial to ensure widespread and equitable agrarian modernization. || E. Equipped with multispectral sensors, they can precisely spray pesticides only on infected crop patches.
explanation: B Drones ka agriculture me use introduce karta hai. E 'they' (drones) ka use karke batata hai ki wo kaise precisely pesticide spray karte hain (B-E pair). A 'This targeted application' directly E ke 'precisely spray' karne ke process ko bolta hai aur uska fayda (reduced chemical runoff) batata hai. C 'Despite these ecological benefits' (in paryavaran faydon ke bawajood) A ke faydon ko refer karke high cost ki problem lata hai. D 'Subsidizing this technology' se is cost problem (C) ka final solution deta hai.
trick: C me 'these ecological benefits' hai jo A ke 'chemical runoff reduce' hone ko bolta hai. C bina A ke galat jagah fit nahi ho sakta.
tip: 'Despite' hamesha positive tone ke baad negative tone lata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This linear model generates mountains of toxic waste that end up in massive landfills. || B. A circular economy, conversely, focuses on reusing, repairing, and recycling existing materials. || C. Transitioning to this sustainable model requires a fundamental shift in both corporate and consumer behavior. || D. The traditional industrial economy has long operated on a 'take-make-dispose' linear model. || E. Such regenerative practices not only minimize waste but also significantly lower carbon emissions.
explanation: D traditional industrial economy ke 'linear model' ko introduce karta hai. A 'This linear model' directly D ko refer karke uski burai (toxic waste) batata hai (D-A pair). B 'conversely' (iske ulat) use karke ek naya model (circular economy) lata hai jo reusing pe focus karta hai. E 'Such regenerative practices' B ke 'reusing, repairing, recycling' ko refer karke uske fayde batata hai. C 'this sustainable model' (B aur E ka model) ko apnane ka final requirement batata hai.
trick: B me 'conversely' (iske vipreet) hai. Yeh traditional linear model (D, A) ke negatives ke baad circular economy ke positives introduce karta hai.
tip: Contrasting pairs (Linear vs Circular) ko samajhne ke liye 'conversely' keyword dhoondo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) is rapidly emerging as one of the greatest global public health threats. || C.
