It occurs when bacteria evolve and develop the ability to defeat the drugs designed to kill them. || E. Averting this post-antibiotic apocalypse requires strict regulations on over-the-counter antibiotic sales.
explanation: B Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) ka introduction hai. D 'It occurs when' se AMR ka definition/mechanism (bacteria evolving) batata hai (B-D pair). A 'This adaptive mechanism' directly D ke 'evolve and develop' process ko bolta hai aur iska effect (medications ineffective) batata hai. C 'Consequently' (isliye) A ka final life-threatening effect batata hai (minor injuries dangerous ho jati hain). E 'this post-antibiotic apocalypse' se is disaster ko rokne ka solution deta hai.
trick: A me 'adaptive mechanism' D ke process ka scientific naam hai. D ke turant baad A aayega.
tip: 'It' hamesha sentence ke main subject (AMR) ko directly replace karta hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. However, the centralized nature of this digital ledger raises severe privacy concerns. || B. Establishing robust cryptographic firewalls is therefore essential to protect individual financial anonymity. || E. explanation: B sovereign digital currency introduce karta hai. A 'However' (halanki) use karke is currency ki 'centralized nature' se aane wale privacy concerns ko highlight karta hai. E 'It theoretically grants' A ke state centralized control ko describe karta hai ki state har transaction dekh sakti hai (A-E pair). C 'such unbridled access' directly E ke 'unprecedented visibility' ko refer karke dystopian effect batata hai. D 'therefore' (ataha) use karke privacy (anonymity) bachane ka solution deta hai.
trick: E me 'It' central bank ya digital currency nahi, balki A me bataya gaya 'centralized nature' hai jisse visibility milti hai. B ke baad directly E nahi aayega.
tip: 'Such unbridled access' jaisi terms ke liye previous sentence me uska context dhoondo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This acidic shift fundamentally destroys the calcium carbonate structures of coral reefs. || B. Protecting these fragile underwater rainforests necessitates an immediate reduction in global fossil fuel consumption. || E. explanation: B oceans ko carbon absorbing sponges batata hai. E 'While this prevents' B ke absorption ka positive effect (less atmospheric warming) batakar negative side (lowers pH level/acidic) lata hai (B-E pair). A 'This acidic shift' seedha E ke lower pH ko refer karta hai aur coral reefs destroy hone ki baat karta hai. C 'this severe bleaching' A ke coral destruction process ko point karta hai aur habitat loss batata hai. D 'these fragile underwater rainforests' (coral reefs) ko bachane ka solution deta hai.
trick: A me 'acidic shift' chemistry term hai jo E ke 'lowers the pH level' ka direct result hai. E ke theek baad A hoga.
tip: Cause (B) -> Tradeoff (E) -> Specific Effect (A) -> Broader Effect (C) -> Solution (D).

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This massive working-age group presents a unique opportunity to propel rapid economic growth. || B. Conversely, failing to create enough adequate jobs for this youth bulge will ignite severe socio-economic unrest. || E. explanation: B 'demographic dividend' introduce karta hai. A 'This massive working-age group' B ko refer karke economic growth ka opportunity batata hai. E 'Realizing this potential' A ki opportunity ko sach karne ke liye skill development ki condition rakhta hai (A-E pair). D 'Conversely' (iske ulat) batata hai ki agar jobs/skills nahi mili to youth bulge se unrest hoga. C is poore scenario (dividend vs disaster) ko balance karne ke liye industrialization ka macro solution deta hai.
trick: D me 'Conversely' hai jo E ke skill investments (positive step) ko fail hone (negative result) se contrast karta hai.
tip: Jab 'potential' ki baat ho (A), uske realization ki shart (E) theek uske baad aati hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This excessive dependence renders the nation highly vulnerable to global supply chain shocks. || B. explanation: B imported microchips par dependence introduce karta hai. A 'This excessive dependence' directly B ko refer karta hai aur uski vulnerability (supply chain shocks) batata hai. D 'Consequently' (isliye) A ke shocks se bachne ke liye government ka solution (incentives for foundries) lata hai. E 'Such localized manufacturing hubs' D ki foundries ko refer karke unka theoretical fayda (insulation) batata hai (D-E pair). C 'this strategic autonomy' (jo E me achieve hui) ko actually banane ka challenge batakar conclude karta hai.
trick: E me 'Such localized manufacturing hubs' D ke 'global foundries' ka dusra naam hai. D aur E sath rahenge.
tip: 'Consequently' problem (A) ke baad government/policy reaction (D) lane ke liye use hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This immutable digital ledger provides unparalleled end-to-end transparency across the entire network. || B. Blockchain technology is slowly revolutionizing the opaque world of global supply chain management. || C. For example, consumers can now instantly verify the ethical sourcing of their coffee beans. || D. Such enhanced traceability significantly curbs the influx of counterfeit products into the retail market. || E. Despite these massive operational advantages, widespread integration is hampered by legacy IT infrastructure.
explanation: B Blockchain aur supply chain ko introduce karta hai. A 'This immutable digital ledger' Blockchain (B) ko describe karta hai aur 'transparency' ka feature batata hai (B-A pair). C 'For example' (udaharan ke liye) A ki transparency ka real-world use batata hai (coffee beans sourcing verify karna). D 'Such enhanced traceability' directly C ke verification process ko point karke ek aur macro fayda (curbing counterfeits) batata hai. E 'Despite these massive operational advantages' saare faydo (A, C, D) ko sum up karke ek limitation batata hai.
trick: C 'For example' hai. Yeh seedha A ke 'transparency' ko prove karta hai. D 'traceability' C ke example ka extension hai.
tip: 'For example' hamesha broad theoretical claim (A) ke baad lagta hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. The fast fashion industry thrives on rapidly replicating runway trends at aggressively cheap prices. || C. Curbing this environmental menace requires strict mandates on extended producer responsibility. || E. Most of these cheap garments are discarded after just a few wears, ending up in overflowing landfills.

A 'This relentless hyper-consumerism' directly E ke throwaway culture ko point karta hai aur textile waste ka problem lata hai. C 'Furthermore' (aur toh aur) se waste (A) ke sath ek aur environmental problem (toxic dyes) add karta hai. D 'this environmental menace' (A aur C ka combination) ko rokne ka law-based solution deta hai.
trick: A 'This relentless hyper-consumerism' us aadat ko bolta hai jahan log saste kapde kharid kar jaldi fainkte hain (E). Isliye E pehle aayega, fir A.
tip: Ek specific activity (E) hamesha ek broad abstract term (hyper-consumerism - A) se pehle aati hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This fusion process releases nearly four million times more energy than burning equivalent fossil fuels. || B. Scientists recently achieved a historic milestone by generating net energy gain in a nuclear fusion experiment. || C. Moreover, it produces zero long-lived radioactive waste, making it environmentally pristine. || D. Commercializing this stellar energy source, however, will still take decades of complex engineering. || E. The experiment successfully replicated the exact physical reactions that power our sun.
explanation: B nuclear fusion experiment ki success batata hai. E 'The experiment' seedha B ko refer karke batata hai ki isne sun ki reaction ko replicate kiya. A 'This fusion process' E ki sun wali reaction ko point karke uski energy output (positive) batata hai (E-A pair). C 'Moreover' (iske atirikt) A ke fayde me ek aur paryavaran fayda (zero waste) jodta hai. D 'however' use karke in sab positives ke beech practical commercialization ka challenge batakar conclude karta hai.
trick: A me 'This fusion process' B ke seedhe baad nahi aa sakta kyunki E me specific 'physical reactions' ka base banaya gaya hai. B-E-A flow sahi hai.
tip: Scientific discoveries me Intro (B) -> Method (E) -> Output (A) -> Benefits (C) -> Future outlook (D).

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This alarming liquidity crunch eventually threatened to destabilize the broader traditional banking system. || B. The sudden collapse of a major infrastructure leasing firm exposed the dark underbelly of shadow banking. || C. Consequently, mutual funds holding these toxic commercial papers faced massive redemption pressures. || D. It triggered an acute crisis of confidence, drying up short-term credit across the entire non-banking sector. || E. To avert a systemic meltdown, the central bank had to inject massive emergency liquidity into the markets.
explanation: B shadow banking collapse introduce karta hai. D 'It triggered' B ke collapse ko refer karke usse aaye crisis aur credit sukhne ki baat karta hai. C 'Consequently' (nateejan) D ka asar batata hai ki mutual funds ko pressure jhelna pada kyunki credit sukh gaya tha. A 'This alarming liquidity crunch' D aur C me jo paise ki kami aayi usko refer karta hai aur traditional banking tak khatra pahunchata hai. E 'To avert a systemic meltdown' (A wale khatre ko taalne ke liye) central bank ka intervention batata hai.
trick: A me 'liquidity crunch' (paise ki kami) tab aayegi jab credit dry hoga (D) aur mutual funds fasenge (C). Sequence D-C-A hoga.
tip: Economic chain reactions hamesha chronological hoti hain. Collapse -> Panic -> Crunch -> Meltdown -> Rescue.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This glaring digital divide renders the technological innovation useless for the most marginalized populations. || B. Telemedicine platforms have significantly democratized access to specialized healthcare services. || C. For instance, rural patients can now consult top-tier urban cardiologists without traveling hundreds of miles. || D. However, the seamless operation of these platforms requires robust high-speed broadband connectivity. || E. Such infrastructure is practically non-existent in remote, economically backward villages.
explanation: B telemedicine ka positive impact (democratized access) lata hai. C 'For instance' se B ka example deta hai ki rural patients urban doctors se mil sakte hain (B-C pair). D 'However' (parantu) se contrast lata hai ki iske liye high-speed internet chahiye. E 'Such infrastructure' seedha D ke 'broadband connectivity' ko refer karta hai aur uski kami batata hai (D-E pair). question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This seamless virtual universe promises to radically revolutionize how we work, socialize, and consume entertainment. || B. The Metaverse envisions a highly immersive internet where physical and digital realities intimately converge. || C. These sensory limitations currently prevent the futuristic concept from achieving true mainstream adoption. || D. To access this realm, users currently must rely on clunky and disorienting Virtual Reality headsets. || E. Moreover, persistent concerns regarding data privacy and user surveillance cast a long shadow over its future.
explanation: B defines the Metaverse. A refers to it as 'This seamless virtual universe' and lists its positive promises (B-A pair). D shifts to the practical aspect of 'accessing this realm', introducing the problem of 'clunky headsets'. C uses 'These sensory limitations' to refer directly to the 'disorienting headsets' in D. E uses 'Moreover' (iske alawa) to add another separate problem (data privacy) to conclude the critique.
trick: C ka 'sensory limitations' (dekhne/mehsoos karne ki dikkat) D ke 'VR headsets' ka problem hai. D-C link solid hai.
tip: Technology passage structure: Concept (B) -> Potential (A) -> Hardware limitation (D) -> Effect (C) -> Policy limitation (E).

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph. || A. This cascading sequence of automated selling can instantaneously wipe trillions of dollars from the global economy. || B. High-Frequency Trading (HFT) algorithms dominate modern stock exchanges, executing millions of orders per second. || C. To prevent such apocalyptic financial meltdowns, regulators must implement robust algorithmic circuit breakers. || D. However, these complex mathematical models are highly susceptible to sudden market anomalies and false data. || E. When triggered by such anomalies, they blindly initiate massive sell-offs without any rational human oversight.
explanation: B introduces HFT algorithms positively (dominating exchanges). D uses 'However' (parantu) to introduce a vulnerability in 'these complex mathematical models' (anomalies). E explains what happens 'When triggered by such anomalies' (massive sell-offs). A uses 'This cascading sequence' to describe the 'massive sell-offs' in E and points out the global economic danger (wipe trillions). C offers a regulatory solution to 'such apocalyptic financial meltdowns'.
trick: E me 'such anomalies' direct point karta hai D ke 'sudden market anomalies' ko. D aur E lagatar aayenge.
tip: 'When triggered' cause and effect ka indicator hai. Pehle cause (D) aayega, fir trigger (E).
